description: Full public details of one dance event on udansa: title and description in the requested language, category, styles, start and end with time zone, venue, organizer (null for events curated by udansa), artists, programme, ticket categories with price and remaining tickets, add-ons, free places, series (next date), waitlist and whether tickets can be bought on udansa (booking.reason says why not, booking.tickets where tickets are instead - udansa gives no external ticket links). Link: url.

id.description: Event id, as returned by search_dance_events.

language.description: Two-letter language code for translated texts and the page link.

name: get_event_details
title: Dance event details
